data.gender_notes: Gaeta is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Gaeta is a Latin name derived from the word ‘gatius’. It originally means ‘watchman’ or ‘guardian’. In ancient Rome, a gatius was a protector or defender, often of a city or temple. In Christian tradition, Gaeta is a strong and faithful name, representing protection and watchfulness over one's community or loved ones. The name Gaeta carries the meaning “Watchman, guardian” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Gaeta usually hope their child will grow to embody watchman, guardian and live with faith, good character and purpose.
